title: audit detail read.session.get_operation
description: detail of audit rows with action read.session.get_operation: session platform read reported by the runner (03-api.md section 10 platform.read). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.

read_wg_id.description: the workgroup read (ADR-087 section 4); null on the organization level or when the read stopped before a workgroup was chosen
